messages.text:
I’ve set up a combined proposal for **BRL 389.80** for the tin and straw set. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a “yes” in chat doesn’t confirm it. (refund-policy/v2/approval) The amount is based on what you paid for those items. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

It does **not** mean a bank will pay you immediately. After you confirm, a staff member must approve it before the shop can pay. The receipt records the refund in the shop’s test ledger, not a bank transfer, and the shop gives no date for money to appear on a card. (refund-policy/v2/approval) (refund-policy/v2/payout)
